fact: The Accountant General's Department issued on 8 May 2025 a request for expressions of interest, funded by the Government of Malawi, for a new Local Authority IFMIS covering Local Revenue Management and integrated with commercial banks, the Reserve Bank and the central IFMIS, to be handed over to Government.
title: Request for Expression of Interest: Design, Development, Deployment, Training and Support of the New Local Authority Integrated Financial Management Information System
